_comment: Vanilla wall signs are entity-rendered — there is no block/pale_oak_wall_sign.json, so flatten_block_model 404s and the docs viewer fell back to a gray cube. Hand-authored stand-in: a thin plank panel against the NORTH wall (z 0..2), so its front face (+Z) faces SOUTH by default; placed3d rotates it to the sign's `facing` and overlays the sign text. Textured with pale_oak_planks (fetchable from MC_ASSETS_BASE).
